title: Find the full name of the tallest human superhero who has a durability attr
question: Find the full name of the tallest human superhero who has a durability attribute value below 50 and is not among the fastest (i.e., does not have a speed attribute value of 100).

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_020" FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS R ON T1."XCL_025" = R."XCL_016" WHERE R."XCL_017" = 'Human' AND T1."XCL_018" IN (SELECT T2."XCL_009" FROM hero_attribute AS T2 INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003" WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Durability' AND T2."XCL_011" < 50) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS T4 INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003" WHERE T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed' AND T4."XCL_011" = 100 AND T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009") ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_020"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS R ON T1."XCL_025" = R."XCL_016"
WHERE R."XCL_017" = 'Human'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T2
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
    WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
      AND T2."XCL_011" < 50
      AND T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
    WHERE T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
      AND T4."XCL_011" = 100
      AND T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS R ON T1."XCL_025" = R."XCL_016"
WHERE R."XCL_017" = 'Human'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T2
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
    WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
      AND T2."XCL_011" < 50
      AND T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"

  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
    WHERE T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
      AND T4."XCL_011" = 100
      AND T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_020"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS R ON T1."XCL_025" = R."XCL_016"
WHERE R."XCL_017" = 'Human'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T2
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
    WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
      AND T2."XCL_011" < 50
      AND T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
    WHERE T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
      AND T4."XCL_011" = 100
      AND T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC
LIMIT 1
